lines.en: Look at the window. The light is golden.
Wow, the wall has a soft glow, Grandma.
lines.ko: 할머니, 와, 벽에 은은한 빛이 있어요.

lines.en: Yes. The evening light is gentle. Do you like it?
lines.ko: 네. 저녁 빛은 부드러워요. 마음에 들어요?

lines.en: I love it. But why is the shadow so long?
lines.ko: 정말 좋아요. 그런데 그림자가 왜 이렇게 길어요?

lines.en: The sun is low now. Shadows grow long.
This morning the shadow was short.
Right. And the sky was pale this morning.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 그리고 오늘 아침 하늘은 옅었어요.

lines.en: Will the sky turn red later?
Yes, it will turn vivid red soon.
lines.ko: 네, 곧 선명한 빨강으로 변할 거예요.

lines.en: Let's watch it together!
Excuse me. Do you like this painting too?
Yes, I do. The colors are so vivid.
I like the golden tone of the sky.
And the water reflects the light. So beautiful.
lines.ko: 그리고 물이 빛을 비춰요. 정말 아름다워요.

lines.en: The shade under the tree looks cool.
Do you see the pale shadow on the road?
Yes. It's gentle and soft.
I came here last year. It looked different then.
lines.ko: 작년에 여기 왔었어요. 그때는 달라 보였어요.

lines.en: Will you come again next year?
Yes, I will. Thank you for talking with me.
lines.ko: 네, 올 거예요. 이야기 나눠 줘서 고마워요.
